description.value: Country Grocer is a family-owned supermarket chain founded on Vancouver Island in the 1980s, now operating eleven stores across Greater Victoria, Salt Spring, and the Cowichan Valley. The Esquimalt location is a full-service store with deli, bakery, seafood, and fresh produce departments, emphasizing locally sourced BC products. It is a dependable resupply stop for touring cyclists riding through the Greater Victoria area.
